implementation.target_stack: Next.js (App Router, client components) + Tailwind CSS + GSAP 3 (with SplitText) + Lenis 1.3. Assumed because the target stack field was left unfilled; every snippet is a plain ES module usable inside a 'use client' component or useEffect.
recommended_libraries: gsap (core + SplitText) as the tween engine; its expo, power and sine eases map 1:1 to the source curves
lenis 1.3.x for duration-based wheel smoothing with native touch
three.js only if replicating the WebGL-synced media layer (optional)

ai_replication_prompt: You are implementing a cinematic, restrained motion system called Mission-Console Cinematic Motion. Import motion-tokens.js and motion-presets.js and use only their tokens. Entrances use ease-out-expo: content groups slide in with slide-in-from-start (translateX(-10%) plus opacity, 1000ms, 200ms base delay, 100ms stagger in DOM order) while their divider runs rule-draw (scaleX from the left edge, 1500ms). Trigger reveals once per mount with a 5% IntersectionObserver threshold (50% for text-heavy sections), and animate immediately if the element is already on screen. The single primary heading per page uses hero-line-mask-reveal (masked lines from y 100%, 1000ms, 100ms apart) after the page transition finishes; hero media uses hero-media-fade. Short uppercase labels and one-line descriptions use text-scramble-decode (500ms, ease-in-out-sine progress, random letters for text or digits for numbers, spaces and punctuation preserved, clean text restored). Numbers use roller-counter. Reveal exits run at about half the entrance duration and move the other way (rule-retract-exit, +10%, origin on the right edge, 700ms). Hover feedback is typographic: link-underline-draw-replay on text links, sibling-dim-focus in nav groups, accordion-fill-wipe on rows, media-hover-zoom inside clipped frames, close-button-rotate on close icons, plus-rotate-toggle for expand icons. Never lift cards, never use springs or bounce. Navigation: header-scroll-coupled-hide (offset from accumulated scroll delta, half rate down on desktop, full rate up), header-frost-on-scroll after 30px, one shared mega-menu-height-expand panel with nav-scrim-fade, and mobile-menu-slide on small screens. Overlays: modal-blur-backdrop (1000ms, symmetric) and side-panel-slide (250ms ease-in-out-quad, symmetric); animate the backdrop first, then focus the close control; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger. Route changes use page-transition-scale-crossfade (freeze old page, reset scroll, scale 1 to 1.02 and overlay in over 350ms ease-out-sine) then page-transition-settle-in (scale 0.98 to 1 and overlay out over 350ms ease-in-sine) with page-load-progress-bar. Scrolling uses smooth-scroll-inertia on wheel only. Carousels use carousel-drag-snap. Gate every hover reveal with (hover: hover) and give touch an in-view equivalent. Respect prefers-reduced-motion using each pattern's reduced_motion_fallback. Use real buttons with aria-expanded for every disclosure.

gaps.issue: None supplied. Timing comes from code; perceived choreography across a full scroll was not recorded.
gaps.suggested_approach: Capture a 60fps recording of a slow then fast scroll on the landing page and one route change to confirm the relative start times of overlapping patterns.

gaps.issue: The automated browser pane paused requestAnimationFrame when not painting, so screenshots timed out and runtime header offsets were stale. Visual behaviour was reconstructed from the application bundle and stylesheet instead.
gaps.suggested_approach: Re-run the interaction sweep in a foreground desktop browser and log the header --header-offset variable and document.getAnimations() during scroll.

gaps.issue: The app did not boot under mobile emulation in the test pane, so touch target sizes and the mobile menu were not measured live. The touch_target_min_px value is inferred from CSS.
gaps.suggested_approach: Test on a real device or a foreground emulator at 375px and 768px; measure hit areas of circle buttons, menu buttons and footer toggles.

gaps.issue: The scramble loop is registered with a framework render call taking a second numeric argument of 20, interpreted as about 20 updates per second. Not verified against framework source.
gaps.suggested_approach: Record the scramble at high frame rate and count distinct character changes per second.

gaps.issue: The target stack field in the brief was left as a placeholder, so Next.js + Tailwind + GSAP + Lenis was assumed.
gaps.suggested_approach: Tell me the actual stack and the snippets can be re-expressed (for example Framer Motion variants or plain CSS).

gaps.area: Form required indicator and empty states
gaps.issue: No required marker styling and no empty listing state were confirmed; filters and pagination were not exercised live.
gaps.suggested_approach: Submit a live form empty and invalid in a foreground browser, and apply a filter combination with no results.

gaps.issue: Compiled shader bundle and 3D scene behaviour (fluid cursor effect, particle headers, 3D product viewer) were not decoded beyond their scroll and transition uniforms.
gaps.suggested_approach: Treat WebGL as optional progressive enhancement; if needed, inspect the shader bundle and scene configuration JSON separately.

gaps.issue: Chart and chapter animations were sampled from code only; the animation switch lives in that template's header and was not exercised.
gaps.suggested_approach: Open a long-form page and toggle the switch with reduced motion on and off.

gaps.issue: Result rendering, debounce timing and keyboard navigation within results were not traced.
gaps.suggested_approach: Type into the search field live and inspect network timing and result focus behaviour.
